descricao_original: Capillaries, the smallest vessels, are composed of endothelial cells and their basal laminae. Generally, only a single endothelial cell nucleus is seen in section, however, multiple cells form a mosaic as they extend around the lumen, forming the capillary tube. Junctions between the endothelial cells are also visible. Endothelial cells are extremely thin to facilitate gas and nutrient exchange with surrounding tissue. 10,000x
